scope: Initial contribution audit; closest verified references among reviewed sources, not an exhaustive novelty search

items.proposed: Combining convolution, feature attention and Transformers improves SR
items.prior_work: RCAN: channel reweighting; SwinIR: residual Transformer restoration
items.difference: Compact cat-v1 feature paths and explicit seven-way implementation registry, rather than a demonstrated new operator
items.needed: Component removal, matched complete budgets, identical data and multiple seeds with independent-region uncertainty
items.observed: 39 historical bindings across five IDs; M2/M6 lack trained bindings. Partial-cost search finds no eligible M2 width.
items.supported_claim: Implementation and artifact-compatibility contribution only; architectural novelty and seven-model superiority are not established

items.proposed: Learned residual reliability produces a reconstruction gain
items.prior_work: Residual reconstruction in SwinIR; project controls include fixed residual attenuation
items.difference: Explicitly testing whether a learned gate adds benefit beyond simply reducing residual magnitude
items.needed: Gain and offset controls, component-removal ablations, matched budgets and independent-scene replication before making a reliability claim
items.observed: Existing pilot interpretation admits attenuation as an explanation; paper tables preserve all recorded pilot rows and seed dispersion.
items.supported_claim: Negative/inconclusive pilot finding; learned reliability is not established

items.proposed: Large multiscale output demonstrates recovered satellite detail
items.prior_work: SwinIR restoration benchmarks require reference-based evaluation, not output-size evidence
items.difference: Exact-dimension cascades, resource preflight and disk-backed export are engineering capabilities
items.needed: Trained representative cascade/seam tests plus calibrated aligned independent cross-sensor references; spectral and downstream evidence where valid
items.observed: Random-weight native-scale seam checks and synthetic reflectance conversion/export tests; these are not quality or transfer experiments.
items.supported_claim: Bounded implementation evidence only; no measured physical resolving-power or cross-sensor improvement
